s.zh: 施法奖励专长：法师、牧师、德鲁伊、术士、邪术师、吟游诗人的职业等级 1、5、10、15 级各 1 个，免费、不占属性提升，只能换法术类专长（战争施法者、法术狙击、魔法学徒、元素使、仪式施法者、心灵感应、妖精之触、坚毅心智、治疗者、幸运、警觉、坚韧、观察者、技能专家、音乐家、演员，以及施法职业自己的职业专属专长）。
s.en: Spellcasting bonus feats: one each at class levels 1, 5, 10 and 15 of wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock and bard, free and not taking an ability score improvement; they can only be spell feats (War Caster, Spell Sniper, Magic Initiate, Elemental Adept, Ritual Caster, Telepathic, Fey Touched, Resilient Mind, Healer, Lucky, Alert, Tough, Observant, Skill Expert, Musician, Actor, and the spellcasting class's own class feats).
